artworks.title: The Villa Imperiale
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, brown wash, and incised on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a top-down view of an architectural scene drawn with pen-and-ink. The composition includes various structures, an elliptical base with inscriptions, a grand building with archways and multiple floors, lush trees in the background, and a monochrome color palette with fine line work and cross-hatching for shading and texture.

artworks.title: Hercules and Antaeus
artworks.artist: Cristofano Robetta, after Antonio del Pollaiuolo
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 26.7 x 19.9 cm (10 1/2 x 7 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two muscular figures in a dynamic struggle. One figure is lifting the other above its head. The background includes rocky terrain and scattered clouds. A small winged creature is depicted to the right. Strong lines and careful shading define muscles and contours.

artworks.title: Patience d'eau, étude (Study of a Patience-Dock)
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and roulette on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth Fine and Larry Day in memory of George Parides
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of dense plant life next to a small body of water. Large leaves and tall grasses are depicted with fine lines. In the background, there is a weathered stone structure partially hidden by vegetation. The monochrome palette emphasizes light and shadow in the intricate natural scene.

artworks.title: Angelus Ministrans
artworks.medium: brush and gold paint on wove paper prepared with black watercolor
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 25 x 13.3 cm (9 13/16 x 5 1/4 in.)
overall: 35.6 x 27.9 cm (14 x 11 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright, holding a long staff in their left hand, which extends from the ground up beyond their shoulder. The person is gazing slightly to their left. Their hands suggest they are resting or possibly clasping something. The facial features are delicate and softly outlined; the person has wavy hair that is longer on the sides, secured with a headband or wrap, and flows down around the face. Their attire consists of a voluminous, draped garment that falls in multiple folds down to their feet, suggesting movement or depth. A tied sash at the waist gathers the garment. In the background, the scene has a dark, almost monochrome appearance, emphasizing the light and shaded contrast of the figure, which adds a dramatic element to the composition. The background lacks distinct elements, focusing attention on the figure itself.

artworks.title: Magnificent Catafalque in Honor of John III, King of Poland
artworks.medium: pen and brown and gray inks with gray wash over graphite on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Peter W. Josten in memory of Stephen Spector
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate architectural or sculptural monument. The drawing depicts a highly ornate structure with classical and Baroque elements, featuring multiple decorative columns, statues, and intricate reliefs. The monument is adorned with various sculptural details including urns, medallions, and human figures, topped with tall spires and flames. The composition highlights the grandeur and opulence of the design, with precise lines and shading emphasizing the depth and perspective. The careful attention to detail suggests the artist's focus on both architectural accuracy and artistic embellishment.

artworks.title: The Exploded Tower, Heidelberg Castle
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: This image shows an old stone ruin surrounded by foliage. The structure has archways and is covered in vines and trees. A wooden fence runs in the foreground. The color palette is monochromatic, highlighting textures and contrasts. Light and shadow play up the decay of the structure.

artworks.title: Passage des Deux-Soeurs de la rue Lafayette
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image shows a cobblestone street in an urban setting. The street is narrow and surrounded by buildings. Some buildings are old with shuttered windows, while others are more modern. A sign that reads "VINS No 10" is visible in the distance, suggesting small establishments along the street. The color palette is sepia, highlighting the aged architecture. The cobblestones lead the eye into the distance, creating a warm and muted ambiance.

artworks.title: Chalet de Handeck, Hasli Valley, Canton Bern, Switzerland
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image shows a mountainous landscape with rugged terrain. Snow-capped mountains dominate the horizon with jagged peaks. Tall pine trees are scattered across rocky terrain. Wooden structures blend into the landscape. The color palette is sepia, with soft shadows and highlights, creating depth in the scene.

artworks.title: Auguste Vacquerie at a Window, Marine Terrace
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person's body leaning out of a window. The person faces forward, looking outside. Their facial features are obscured due to the texture and lighting. The person appears to have light-colored hair and wears dark clothes. There is no visible jewelry, and they are not holding any object. The background is an exterior building wall with a window featuring shutters on both sides. Below the window is a section of the building's roof. The scene is in a vintage, sepia-toned style, giving it an aged appearance. The area around the person is textured, adding an artistic effect.

artworks.title: The Hunts of Maximilian: The Stag Hunt (August)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Brown Foundation, Inc., Houston
artworks.description: The image depicts a forest scene with an elevated point of view, showing various activities and landscapes. The horizon is high and marked by a line of trees. In the foreground, hunters and dogs are chasing a deer, surrounded by tall trees with detailed textures. The color palette includes browns, greens, and grays, creating a sense of age and enhancing the natural setting. Further away, more hunters and animals can be seen among a vast expanse of fading trees towards the horizon, emphasizing depth and scale.

artworks.title: Design for an Inlaid Circular Table Top, with Alternatives
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray and black washes over graphite on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (circular): 32.5 x 32.5 cm (12 13/16 x 12 13/16 in.)
mount: 42.8 x 40.6 cm (16 7/8 x 16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a circular design filled with intricate shapes and lines forming radial symmetry. At the center is a star-like pattern with multiple points radiating outward, surrounded by abstract motifs resembling ornate leaves and scrolls. Oval shapes, similar to the outline of leaves, are evenly distributed around the central star, each set within detailed ornamental designs. The composition is reminiscent of classic architectural elements and combines them into a unified circular form.

artworks.title: Elevation for a Church Facade, with Alternatives
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray and brown washes over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an illustration of an architectural facade. It shows a detailed building front with Baroque style. The facade has elaborate carvings, decorations, columns, pilasters with moldings, niches with sculptures, and a grand entrance. Additional sculptures are positioned at the top and by the entryway. The design emphasizes symmetry and grandeur typical of Baroque architecture.

artworks.title: Ground Plan for an Academy of the Fine Arts
artworks.medium: pen and black and green inks with black wash over graphite on 4 joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts architectural floor plans. It shows a detailed plan of a structure with a central circular hub and three radiating wings containing rooms or spaces. The plan is drawn with precision lines and includes notations. The design appears symmetrical with a focus on the central circle. Architectural elements like walls, doors, and columns are marked, showcasing a thoughtful design process.

artworks.title: Rotunda in Gothic Style
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This image shows an ornate architectural interior with gothic arches, sculptures, intricate carvings, and relief decorations. The space features detailed pilasters, niches with sculpted figures, and geometric patterns typical of gothic architecture. Light enters through arched windows on the left, casting shadows that emphasize the stonework details. The drawing is in monochrome with shading to highlight textures and depth of the architectural elements.

artworks.title: Interior of a Barn Built on Ancient Ruins
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown chalk over graphite on wove paper, incised for transfer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior with various wooden beams and structures. The drawing depicts a wooden interior with a large open area, overhead wooden beam structure, high ceiling, staircase leading up to a balcony with railings, barrels, and a ladder against a pillar. In the background, there are hints of other buildings and trees, indicating a larger rural complex or village. The style is detailed, focusing primarily on the architectural elements and their interactions with the surroundings.

artworks.title: Peasant Walking along a River
artworks.medium: etching on oatmeal paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a large tree on the right side and a pathway next to water leading to the left. There are hills and a mountain range in the distance. The horizon is not clearly defined. The artwork seems to be an etching or detailed pencil sketch, with intricate linework creating texture for leaves, rocks, and water. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black, white, and grey. A person with a basket is on the path, adding scale to the scene. In the background, there are hills, foliage, and ruins on the left, and cliffs or rocks on the right.

artworks.title: Woman and Child Walking to Church
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a woodland path with a woman and a child standing slightly off-center. The scene includes dense trees, foliage, a winding path, and rock formations in the distance. The etching features intricate lines and crosshatching, creating a textured effect. The monochromatic palette of black and white emphasizes light and shadow.

artworks.title: Doorway of Farnese Palace
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural doorway. The image shows a classical doorway design with a large door, square panel pattern, an arched transom window with a radiating fan design, an ornate stone facade with symmetrical detailing, and an entablature with a central coat of arms, surrounded by inscriptions. The drawing is detailed with fine lines, giving depth and texture to the stone and architectural elements.

artworks.title: Dutch Facade Elevation: pl. 5
artworks.artist: Vignola (author) and anonymous engraver after Philips Vingboons
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two architectural facade designs. The image presents detailed line drawings of two multi-story buildings with intricate architectural embellishments. The facade on the left features decorations such as pilasters, arched windows, and cartouches, with a triangular pediment topping its design. The windows are aligned symmetrically. The facade on the right displays a stepped gable with symmetrical window arrangements and arched detailing over the windows. Both buildings are portrayed with emphasis on their verticality and decorative elements, suggesting a Baroque or Renaissance influence.

artworks.title: Dutch Facade Elevation: pl. 3
artworks.artist: Vignola (author) and anonymous engraver after Philips Vingboons
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural facade. The image shows a symmetrical building front with decorative window frames, columns, and an arched doorway. The facade has ornamentation such as scrollwork and a garland-like decoration at the top, along with circular and rectangular accents. The bottom section includes windows with wrought-iron grills, while the ground level features a main door with steps. The drawing highlights classical architectural elements with precise linework, conveying elegance and order in its design.

artworks.title: Pedimented Windows
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of an elaborate architectural structure featuring classical details such as pilasters, a central niche or panel, two archways on each side, and stone-like textures. The composition shows symmetry and balance, typical of classical or renaissance-inspired architecture.

artworks.title: Pedimented Doorway
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural doorframe featuring elaborate stone masonry and detailed carvings. The image depicts a detailed doorframe with classical architectural elements such as columns, entablatures, and decorative urns. The frame is adorned with intricate patterns of lines and textures giving it a three-dimensional appearance. The top of the door features a pediment with a central ornament, while the columns on either side are fluted and rest upon plinths with crisscross designs. The emphasis is on symmetry and geometric shapes, showcasing a balance between structural elements and decorative embellishments.

artworks.title: Triumphal Doorway
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural facade. The detailed Corinthian columns and intricate carvings, such as cherubic figures and reliefs, are prominently featured. The design includes arches and scrollwork, with a focus on symmetry and elaboration. The base of the structure has smaller detailed elements. The richness in the patterns and balanced proportions reflects a classical style of architecture.

artworks.title: The Fall of Phaeton
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and red washes over black chalk, heightened with white and indented for transfer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene. The image depicts dynamic figures and swirling clouds. Central to the composition is a semi-nude male figure falling through the air amidst an assembly of other figures. The scene is filled with motion, with figures both ascending and descending among the clouds. The figures are depicted with emphasis on anatomy and dynamic poses. The drawing has a monochromatic brown tone. The overall scene suggests a mythological or epic narrative, typical of baroque compositions, with complex interactions among figures creating a sense of energy and movement.
